Warranty - How to make a warranty claim
Submit a claim through the Warranty Desk form with your order number and a photo of the defect. Claims are reviewed within 5 business days. Approved claims receive a replacement unit, not a cash refund.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/repairs.md">
Out-of-Warranty Repairs - Repair turnaround
Repairs are completed within 10 business days of the product arriving at the Brindlewick repair center in Dayton, Ohio.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/repairs.md">
Out-of-Warranty Repairs - Repair guarantee
Every repair comes with a 6 month guarantee on the replaced parts. If a product cannot be repaired, the repair fee is refunded in full and you receive a 20% discount code toward a replacement.
</document>

Question: How long does it take to review a warranty claim?
response: Claims are reviewed within 5 business days.
